pmc-11370691.creator: Yang Cai, Lingchuan Deng, Jun Yao
pmc-11370691.description: BackgroundRheumatoid arthritis (RA) is an autoimmune, inflammatory joint disease. There is growing evidence that ferroptosis is involved in the pathogenesis of RA. pmc-12608836.title: Best Practices and Communication Strategies for Informing Oncology Patients About Treatment Discontinuation and Transition to Palliative Care—A Practical Guide for Oncologists
pmc-12608836.creator: Aleksandra Piórek, Adam Płużański, Dariusz M Kowalski, Maciej Krzakowski, Albert Tuca-Rodríguez
pmc-12608836.description: Simple SummaryDiscontinuing active oncological treatment and initiating palliative care is one of the most complex challenges in cancer care. This narrative review provides oncologists with practical guidance for these difficult conversations. Drawing on clinical guidelines, scientific literature, and expert opinion, we propose a structured communication strategy and introduce a practical algorithm to support informed and compassionate decision-making.

pmc-13083131.title: Exploring the potential of oxymatrine in preventing CHIKV-induced acute kidney injury based on multi-dimensional computational analysis and in vitro experiments
pmc-13083131.creator: JiaLiang Xin, FangJun Li, LuLu Kang, Jie Yang, HaiTong Wang, Wei Wang, Sheng Feng, XinFei Liao, WenJie Li, He Zhang
pmc-13083131.description: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) infection can induce acute kidney injury (AKI) and may be fatal in severe cases, yet effective therapeutic strategies remain unclear. This study integrated computational analysis (network pharmacology and molecular docking) with in vitro experiments to evaluate the protective potential of oxymatrine against CHIKV-induced AKI and to explore its underlying mechanisms.

pmc-13129617.title: Cross‐Cultural Adaptation, Reliability and Validation of the Mini‐OAKHQoL for Knee/Hip Osteoarthritis in a Syrian Arabic‐Speaking Population: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13129617.creator: Ruba Altahla, Jamal Alshorman
pmc-13129617.description: Background and AimsOsteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative joint disease characterized. The Mini‐Osteoarthritis Knee and Hip Quality of Life (Mini‐OAKHQoL) scale is used to evaluate the impact of knee/hip osteoarthritis (KOA/HOA) on patients' quality of life (QoL). This study aims to ascertain the consistency and accuracy of the Mini‐OAKHQoL Syrian Arabic version.

pmc-13350978.description: Leucine-rich-repeat-containing protein 15 (LRRC15) is selectively expressed on cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) and constitutes a promising biomarker for imaging the tumor microenvironment. Using a combinatorial library approach, assisted by machine learning, we developed disulfide-constrained peptides (DCPs), notably ML-YSD-07 and ML-PD-03, that demonstrate subnanomolar affinities for murine LRRC15 (muLRRC15) and specifically localize onto muLRRC15-expressing fibroblasts.

pmc-13364010.title: Preventing Black Ice Caused by Freezing Rain and Frost on Sensorless Rural Highways: Winter Maintenance in South Korea
pmc-13364010.creator: Jinhwan Jang
pmc-13364010.description: Black ice poses a significant threat to drivers during winter due to its low visibility. Winter road maintenance personnel face continuous challenges in preventing its formation because of its high unpredictability. To address this issue, this paper proposes a practical strategy for effective winter road maintenance aimed at preventing black ice caused by freezing rain and frost.
